verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs show Docker is part of the system: it offers Windows 'through a Docker VM'. A community security report says the default user was put in the docker group, which implies Docker came preinstalled and usable without extra setup. A defender notes that default was later changed, so how much container tooling works with zero setup today is unclear. missing for 10: first-party docs stating Docker/Podman or other container tools are preinstalled and ready out of the box, current default configuration after the docker-group change, coverage of broader container tooling (compose, lazydocker, etc.), hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use container tools out of the box with no additional setup required

citations.quote: Omarchy offers an easy way to run Windows through a Docker VM.
Omarchy configured its default user as a member of the docker group
